name: ResultFrame
description:
The frame every tool-rendered result shares: an AiCard on the breakout column with a
compact header — glyph, title, data meta (source · count) — and the same three actions
in the same order: copy, export CSV, open in window.
signature: ({ result, icon, meta, copyText, csv, footer, flush, children }: ResultFrameProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: copyText
props.description: Text for the copy action; omit to hide it.

props.name: csv
props.description: CSV for export; omit to hide it.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content after the body, normally supporting actions.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: meta
props.description: Data line after the source: "8 of 1,284", "3 images".

props.name: result
props.description: Typed result, including disclosure and rendering metadata.
